boardRow.name: The Claim
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: The classic river claim.

goals: Survive through wave 10.
rules: The river splits the claim around one center ford.
Pressure comes from all four edges until wave 10 seals the claim; stay for the Rush if you want to press your luck.
briefing.geographyLine: The classic river claim.

boardRow.name: The Drill Yard
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Practice ground: no stakes, no claim. The county lends the gold; the straw men lend their patience.

goals: Try every Frontier building.
Practice on the straw men and rolling logs.
rules: Pull the assay-tent lever to top up practice gold.
Ring the Drill Bell for one small wave.
Nothing in the yard enters the county ledger.
briefing.geographyLine: A borrowed corner of the river claim at the edge of town.

engineDependencies.description: Needs consumers for sluice water-source gating; the declared dry-gulch seam yield is tracked separately until that field is single-sourced.

boardRow.name: The Dry Gulch
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Mesa country; dry washes fall toward one sunken spring.

goals: Survive through wave 20.
Work the dry washes around the lone spring.
rules: Sluices work only beside the spring.
The river is gone; enemies can press from every edge.
Seams pay 40% more gold.
briefing.geographyLine: Mesa country; dry washes fall toward one sunken spring.

boardRow.name: Night Shift
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: The claim, gone dark, dotted with cold lanterns.

goals: Survive to DAWN at wave 25.
rules: Beyond your light, the night owns the claim.
Relight cold lanterns or build new posts to see threats.
Turrets still target in the dark.
briefing.geographyLine: The claim, gone dark, dotted with cold lanterns.

boardRow.name: Twin Banks
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A braided river claim with twin fords, gravel bars, and damp reeds.

goals: Survive through wave 20.
Build on either bank and watch both fords.
rules: Both banks can hold buildings.
Two fords carry pressure across the river.
The south stake marks your starting ground; the north marker stands across the braid.
briefing.geographyLine: A braided river claim with twin fords, gravel bars, and damp reeds.

baron.taunt: The Baron sends his regards. The claim won't hold.
baron.defeatBeat: Dragged off by his own men, swearing revenge.
baron.medalBlurb: The Rocket Cart, captured. He'll be back with machines.

boardRow.name: The Claim-Jumper Baron
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: An oxblood banner marks the outfit that keeps buying trouble.

goals: The Baron rides at wave 20. Break his Rocket Cart.
rules: His outfit rides hot: waves come 15% faster.
Taunts warn you before his banner appears.
Turn back the Baron for the medal and double science.
briefing.geographyLine: A brass-bannered bully compresses the waves and waits at the twentieth horn.

engineDependencies.description: Needs registered consumers for the declared slopeMax and waterline advisory fields.

baron.taunt: The Baron's railcar is on the spur. Keep the cut open.
baron.defeatBeat: Boiler cold, wheels locked, the town can graduate into steam.

modes.label: Railhead Escort
modes.objective: See 1 ore cart safely across the rail cut.

boardRow.name: The Hill Mine
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Terraced steamworks ground above a rail cut and flooded gallery.

goals: Build across the terraces and keep watch on the rail cut.
Railhead Escort: see the ore cart safely across for a town payout.
rules: T2 and T3 pads out-range the valley, but cliff faces block bolts.
Claim-jumpers must climb the switchbacks; cliff bands are impassable.
The flooded gallery is deep except at the trestle and wet edge.
Coal seams lie at the mine mouth on the top terrace, north of the boiler-house site.
briefing.geographyLine: A terraced hillside mine above a flooded rail cut.

engineDependencies.description: Needs registered consumers for the declared slopeMax and waterline advisory fields.

baron.taunt: The Baron's railcar is bearing down on the trestle.
baron.defeatBeat: The last ore cart clears the gorge under its own steam.

modes.label: Trestle Crossing
modes.objective: See 1 ore cart safely across the trestle.

boardRow.name: The Trestle
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A rail crossing over the gorge: hold both approaches while the ore carts run.

goals: Build on both approaches and survive through wave 12.
Trestle Crossing: see the ore cart safely over the gorge.
rules: The trestle is the only easy crossing over deep water.
Rail Toughs and Steam Wreckers press both approaches.
The south bank beside the base remains open for sluice work.
Coal seams lie along the mine spur on the south approach, west of the boiler site.
briefing.geographyLine: One long rail line crosses a deep river gorge between defended approaches.

engineDependencies.description: Needs registered consumers for the declared slopeMax and waterline advisory fields.

boardRow.name: The Pressure Garden
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A geothermal terrace garden where coal tends the boilers and pressure is the crop.

goals: Run boilers on the three terraces and watch the pressure ledger.
Survive through wave 12 between the three boiler beds.
rules: The coal seams cluster on the highest terrace above the boiler beds.
The single water band has a broad north bank for legal sluice work.
Steam Wreckers attack from both growing terraces while Coal Thieves descend from the seam bed.
briefing.geographyLine: Four stepped growing terraces rise north of one clean water band.

engineDependencies.description: Needs registered consumers for the declared slopeMax and waterline advisory fields.

baron.taunt: The Baron's railcar has taken the lower line.
baron.defeatBeat: The upper cart crests while the lower railcar cools in the cut.

modes.label: Incline Haul
modes.objective: See 1 ore cart safely up the upper funicular line.

boardRow.name: The Incline
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Twin funicular lines climb the cut: escort the upper haul while defending the lower engine house.

goals: Incline Haul: see an ore cart safely up the upper line.
Defend the lower engine house and stop the Baron's railcar on the lower line.
rules: Two funicular routes cross the water band and climb separate benches.
The lower rail carries the wave-12 railcar; the upper rail carries the escorted ore cart.
The broad banks beside both crossings remain open for sluice work.
Coal seams lie in the lower yard between the haul lines, east of the engine house.
briefing.geographyLine: Twin haul lines climb from one wet lower yard to the ore benches above.

boardRow.name: Blackout Ridge
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: The current comes from beyond the ridge. Bank a breath before the Fever cuts the trunk.

goals: Bank current at the capacitor sites and survive through wave 12.
rules: The off-map trunk brings 36 W; each bank stores 0.05 Wh from surplus current.
A charged bank returns up to 12 W while a cut separates the ridge from its unseen source.
Trunk Saboteurs attack the three pre-authored frames; repair a frame to restore current and recharge.
briefing.geographyLine: An 80 by 96 ridge: the trunk enters from the southwest glow and climbs to the switch house in the northeast.

boardRow.name: Moth Season
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Migration week: every lamp is bait, and one shed pays the nightly tithe.

goals: Hold through wave 12 while the decoy shed draws the migration.
CONNECT the corridor gallery to the dynamo by wave 12.
rules: Moths choose light by radius; the Decoy Shed counts double and takes 6 damage per attached swarm each second.
Darkness is a road: non-moths move 12% faster outside light below 35% coverage.
The cycle stays at night, easing only through two-second dusks.
The corridor lamp runs on the dynamo's current: a Sentry Beacon raised on the CORRIDOR PYLON SITE closes the span, and a wrecked beacon cuts it and puts the lamp out.
REPAIR the beacon to relight the corridor; a corridor that never carried current by wave 12 cannot be secured at any wave.
briefing.geographyLine: Two lit yards flank one unlit north-south corridor, wired dynamo to pylon to gallery lamp.

engineDependencies.description: Needs registered consumers for the declared slopeMax and waterline advisory fields.

baron.taunt: Every lamp dims for one heartbeat.
baron.defeatBeat: The Crawler winds down where it stands, and the town keeps it.
baron.medalBlurb: Broke the Drain-Mast and brought the stolen current home.

modes.label: Capacitor Run
modes.objective: Carry 1 capacitor crate up the west switchback.

boardRow.name: The Canyon Works
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: String the gorge with current; the Fever comes to every light we raise.

goals: Survive through wave 12 from the Dynamo Sub-Hall yard.
CONNECT both cliff galleries by wave 6.
rules: Sentry Beacons raised on marked PYLON SITES carry current up the switchbacks.
Every gallery, lamp, turret, and tram draws watts; the ledger sheds higher-priority numbers first.
Fevered saboteurs are drawn to the grid and cut a span when they wreck a pylon.
briefing.geographyLine: A 96 by 112 gorge: sub-hall south, one dam channel, split switchbacks, and paired galleries above.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the crowd-flock escort objective consumer advertised by the fairground declaration.

boardRow.name: The Fairground
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Keep the wheel turning while the rival pavilions brighten the midway.

goals: DEFEND the Fair Wheel through wave 12.
Keep three festival flocks inside the escort ring as they cross the midway.
rules: The wheel makes 24 W only while it spins; any damage stops the dynamo.
The wheel cabins lift the watch radius to 18 units.
Copper and Silver pavilion lamps widen by 3 units each night.
briefing.geographyLine: An 88 by 88 fairground bowl: wheel north of the gate, rival pavilions west and east, open midway south.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the booted DustFlatsTile consumer for the declared tar seams, roads, ORBIT spawn, and dry wash.

motorFrontier.description: The Dust Flats ride: fuel the Hauler at the camp's three tar nodes, grade the surveyed corridors from their stakes, and haul to the railhead through the storms. The claim cannot be secured until the Hauler rests at the railhead, and on this map that has to happen before the Land-Yacht falls.

baron.taunt: A dust column runs against the weather.
baron.defeatLine: Her sister went looking for the sea.
baron.defeatBeat: The gang takes the bell and leaves the rolling hulk to the town.
baron.medalBlurb: Beached the Land-Yacht and out-ranged its crane.

boardRow.name: The Dust Flats
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A wide motor field ringed by road, derricks, tar seams, and one dry wash.

goals: Build from the Motor Camp into three surveyed fields.
Watch all four horizons across the dry wash.
rules: The ORBIT road circles the outer field.
Twelve derrick claims stand beyond the Motor Camp.
Four tar seams flank one angled dry wash.
briefing.geographyLine: A 160 by 160 drive-scale flat: twelve derrick claims, four tar seams, one dry wash, and the horizon road.

tileParams.description: Linear, 400 units: the map IS a road, a scrolling claim with no fixed pads at all; Haulers only, the town moves or dies. The convoy is the base is the town. Rest stops offer brief anchorage; leaving each one behind is a small goodbye the map makes you practice. Engine dependency: the moving-claim consumer (Hauler-only basing, convoy advance, rest-stop anchorage windows, lead-Hauler loss) does not exist yet.

objectives.description: Bring the convoy the full length of the road to the far railhead.
The town rides with the lead Hauler; losing it ends the run.

teachingIntent.description: Teaches total mobility; attachment travels. The town that learned to BE a convoy will one day be a ship.

engineDependencies.description: Needs a moving-claim consumer: Hauler-only basing with no fixed pads, convoy advance along the road, brief rest-stop anchorage windows, and loss tied to the lead Hauler rather than a fixed stake.

motorFrontier.description: The Long Road ride: the town IS the convoy. Grade the long road from its west stake, fuel the lead Hauler at the tar nodes by the middle way-station, then walk east ahead of it. The town gains exactly the ground the lead Hauler gains toward the far railhead and never the ground it gives back, and 380 units of ungraded road costs far more fuel than the county owns.

boardRow.name: The Long Road
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: One long graded road passes three old way-stations on its way east.

goals: Follow the long west-east road between three old way-stations.
Build around the station grounds and watch every verge.
rules: The graded road runs four hundred units from west to east.
Three surveyed station grounds divide the route.
Waves enter from the north, south, and west.
briefing.geographyLine: A four-hundred-unit graded road runs west to east past three old way-stations.

tileParams.description: A field of pre-built WILD derricks, uncapped, erupting on their own schedules. Cap to claim; every cap triggers a blowout wave; tar sprites everywhere; the map is a boiling economy you tame well-by-well. The outhouse gag from E2's Pressure Garden returns as a crude geyser, once per run, guaranteed. Engine dependency: wild-derrick eruption schedules, cap-to-claim conversion, blowout waves, and seam-spawned tar sprites have no consumer yet.

objectives.description: Cap and claim the wild derricks well by well.
Hold the County Camp through wave 12 while the wells erupt.

teachingIntent.description: Teaches risk sequencing: which geyser do you ride first? The county is a boiling economy tamed well by well.

engineDependencies.description: Needs wild-derrick eruption scheduling, cap-to-claim conversion, the blowout wave each cap triggers, and tar sprites spawning from seams instead of edges.

motorFrontier.description: The Gusher County ride: three lease roads run out of the County Camp and the Hauler has to reach the head of every one. Each storm washes out one lease by the county's own weather clock, carrying no road bonus and taking no delivery while it blows, so ride the open leases first and come back for the closed one when it reopens.

boardRow.name: Gusher County
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Eight wild derricks stand across three leases around the County Camp.

goals: Build from the County Camp across the three leases.
Watch all four edges around the eight derricks.
rules: Eight derricks mark the county's harvest grounds.
Tar seams and surveyed roads divide the leases.
One outhouse geyser marks the eastern field.
briefing.geographyLine: A 160 by 160 derrick county: eight wild gushers on three leases around one camp.

tileParams.description: Where machines go: a valley of dead Flivvers, spent boilers, one half-buried thing nobody names. Salvage economy: strip parts under pressure while pipeline rustlers strip the SAME yard, a race in slow motion over bones. Nothing in the boneyard attacks unless woken, and the map rewards leaving the sleeper asleep; no tooltip ever says so. Engine dependency: the salvage-race consumer (strip-under-pressure economy, rival rustler crews, sleeper wake trigger) does not exist yet.

objectives.description: Strip more of the yard than the pipeline rustlers do.
Hold the Gate Camp through wave 12.

teachingIntent.description: Teaches the economy of the dead and respect for old machines; the yard rewards those who leave the sleeper asleep, and no tooltip ever says so.

engineDependencies.description: Needs a strip-under-pressure salvage economy, rival rustler crews working the same hulks, and the sleeper's wake trigger with its untold reward for leaving it asleep.

motorFrontier.description: The Boneyard ride: one spent boiler comes down to the Gate Camp on the Hauler's hook. Grade the west gate road, fuel at the tar nodes between the rows, hitch the boiler where it lies, and bring it back. A storm does not stop the tow; it makes the same distance cost more fuel, because the Hauler burns by the second and a storm stretches every second out.

boardRow.name: The Boneyard
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Dead Flivvers and spent boilers fill two quiet rows beyond the Gate Camp.

goals: Build from the Gate Camp into the dead-machine rows.
Watch both valley ends while crossing the yard.
rules: Dead Flivvers and spent boilers fill the west and east rows.
Ten harvest grounds lie among the old machines.
Waves enter from the west and east.
briefing.geographyLine: A 128 by 128 valley of dead Flivvers and spent boilers in quiet rows.

engineDependencies.description: Needs a headless Deepwater consumer for claim-boat anchoring and re-anchoring, deck-pad building, the storm and corsair scheduler, the depth ladder, the E5 arsenal, and Dredge-Queen resolution; these run browser-only through DeepwaterClaimTile, DeepwaterArsenal, and DredgeQueenBossSystem.

baron.taunt: A corsair flag rides inside the storm wall.
baron.defeatLine: The sea keeps the hulk and returns the hold.
baron.defeatBeat: The crew rows clear while the cracked hold scatters every salvaged piece back across the wreck site.
baron.medalBlurb: Broke both paddles, cracked the hold, and made the Dredge-Queen another map.

boardRow.name: The Deepwater Claim
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Anchor the floating claim, read the storm glass, and keep the drowned eras below on the chart.

goals: Hold the Claim-Boat through wave 12.
Keep every workshop fastened to a numbered deck anchor.
rules: Buildings fasten to Claim-Boat pads; the water itself takes no foundations.
Storm fronts carry corsair skiffs west to east.
The reef gap admits boats; the wreck shelf and trench obey the depth ladder.
briefing.geographyLine: A 128 by 128 water claim: lagoon anchorage, reef ring, five drowned-era wrecks, and the sealed trench edge.

tileParams.description: A storm-race between beacons while the Claim-Boat remains under attack; the fastest water runs nearest the front. Engine dependency: checkpoint racing and competing-racer loot still need a consumer.

objectives.description: Sail the full beacon course before the corsair racers loot its checkpoints.
Keep the Claim-Boat intact while racing.

teachingIntent.description: Teaches storm-reading as a skill the player can feel improving by rewarding daring lines near the weather front.

engineDependencies.description: Needs a checkpoint race and competing-racer loot consumer; storm scheduling and Claim-Boat movement already exist.

boardRow.name: The Regatta
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: An open-water beacon course bends north from the Claim-Boat and returns.

goals: Cross the north-bending beacon course.
Build from the Claim-Boat deck while watching the western water.
rules: Five beacon gates mark the out-and-back course.
The Claim-Boat deck is the only surveyed build ground.
Waves enter from the west.
briefing.geographyLine: An open-water beacon course bends north toward the fast storm-front water before returning to the finish.

tileParams.description: A fog-bound, stormless variant of the Shelf Reefs where the leviathan hunts every loud machine. Engine dependency: permanent fog, storm suppression, and noise-driven hunting still need a consumer.

objectives.description: Pan by hand, drift on sail trim, and fight only when the fog shivers.
Keep the Claim-Boat quiet enough that the leviathan cannot hold its trail.

teachingIntent.description: Teaches subtraction as mastery and establishes quiet as a place before the Quiet becomes a threat in E10.

engineDependencies.description: Needs permanent fog and storm suppression plus noise emission and leviathan attraction for pumps, engines, and harpoon reloads.

boardRow.name: Stillwater
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: The Shelf Reefs lie under still water around one anchored Claim-Boat.

goals: Build from the Claim-Boat deck among the Shelf Reefs.
Work the five harvest grounds around the anchorage.
rules: Stillwater reuses the Deepwater Claim reef terrain.
Five harvest grounds ring the Claim-Boat.
Waves enter from the north and south.
briefing.geographyLine: The Shelf Reefs lie under glass-still water and unbroken fog; this contract reuses the Deepwater Claim tile.

tileParams.description: A fleet variant of the Shelf Reefs: the base is disaggregated into district hulls and formation is the wall. Engine dependency: distributed hull ownership, straggler targeting, nonfatal loss, and formation reshaping still need a consumer.

objectives.description: Keep the district hulls close enough to cover one another while waves target stragglers.
If a hull is lost, close the gap and continue instead of ending the run.

teachingIntent.description: Teaches redundancy and convoy empathy; in co-op, each rider owns one hull.

engineDependencies.description: Needs multi-hull base ownership, straggler targeting, nonfatal hull loss, formation reshaping, and one-hull-per-rider co-op assignment.

boardRow.name: The Flotilla
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A kitchen scow, turret raft, and still-room barge share the Shelf Reefs.

goals: Build across the kitchen scow, turret raft, and still-room barge decks.
Watch both water approaches around the three hulls.
rules: Each hull carries one surveyed build deck.
Three stake markers identify the hull centers.
Waves enter from the west and east.
briefing.geographyLine: Three district hulls share the Shelf Reefs water tile in a broad defensive formation.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the declared timed decay-field walkability, six-vein night harvest, epoch-wide appliance wrangle, and Homemaker boss consumers; the browser composes E6TileConsumerSystem, WrangleSystem, and HomemakerBossSystem while the headless sim composes none.

baron.defeatLine: The machine makes one chair and sits.
baron.defeatBeat: A DONE pictogram glows over one chair. The Homemaker powers down on warm ground, and the town keeps it.
baron.medalBlurb: Broke the VAC and CORE without ever becoming its target.

boardRow.name: The Glow Mesa
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Hold the kitchen, run the night veins, and wrangle the Combine's tired machines before the dials close.

goals: Defend the Isotope Kitchen.
Harvest the six-vein starstone ring after dark.
Wrangle appliances after they wind down.
rules: Decay-puddle windows open and close on visible timers.
Lawn Shepherds drive appliance herds up the legal-grade scarp paths.
Feral appliances wind down when kited long enough and may then be captured alive.
briefing.geographyLine: A two-level mesa: warehouse origin, legal-grade herd paths, a six-vein caprock ring, and a base flat broken by timed decay fields.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the epoch-wide appliance wrangle consumer: feral machines wind down when kited long enough and may then be captured alive. The browser enables WrangleSystem for the whole Atomic epoch, while the headless sim has no wrangle consumer and the mechanics manifest exposes no capture operation.

boardRow.name: The Showroom
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: An empty model-home village stands between the showroom approach and catalog yard.

goals: Cross the model-home village from the showroom approach to the catalog yard.
Work the six harvest grounds among the display houses.
rules: Model homes surround the central village road.
Three build grounds divide the approach, village, and catalog yard.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
The display houses stand quiet; no household wakes another.
briefing.geographyLine: A pristine, empty model-home village surrounds a catalog-goods yard and one broad showroom approach.

boardRow.name: Half-Life Hollow
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Two glow bridges and one central causeway cross the hollow between four shelves.

goals: Cross the hollow from the south launch shelf to the north extraction shelf.
rules: Two glow bridges flank one central causeway.
West and east shelves divide the middle crossing.
Waves enter from both sides of the hollow.
The north extraction stake stands beyond the causeway.
briefing.geographyLine: A south-to-north hollow of two glow bridges, one central causeway, and two middle shelves.

boardRow.name: The Picnic
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Three sandwich stakes stand on the Glow Mesa's caprock meadow.

goals: Hold the caprock meadow against waves from three sides.
rules: Glow Mesa ground returns beneath the caprock meadow.
Three sandwich stakes mark the meadow.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
The base staging ground lies south of the meadow.
briefing.geographyLine: A Glow Mesa terrain variant with a base staging ground below one caprock meadow.

boardRow.name: The Relay Valley
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Set the ridge chain, chart the quiet pockets, and keep recorded patrols inside its reach.

goals: Link the four ridge relays by line of sight.
Record one patrol and hand it to a drone.
Keep the replay inside linked relay coverage.
rules: Relays connect only when they can see one another.
Recorded patrols stop when they enter a dead zone.
Four relay sites span the two exposed ridges.
briefing.geographyLine: Two exposed relay ridges stand at height five above a thick valley floor, split by a dead gap and line-of-sight fog pockets.

manifest.name: Echo Canyon
manifest.description: Board-launch-only until its broadcast-mirror playbook consumer lands. Teaching intent: vary your own patterns because every recorded habit returns as a corrupted copy on the next wave.

objectiveMetadata.description: Use a playbook, then counter the corrupted copy fielded on the next wave.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Vary your own patterns; your habits have a shadow.

broadcastMirrorZones.description: Everything recorded in this field is mirrored as a corrupted enemy playbook on the next wave.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the playbook broadcast-mirror, echo-band, and objective consumers declared by this contract.

broadcastMirror.description: Each playbook used this run returns as a corrupted enemy copy on the next wave.

boardRow.name: Echo Canyon
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A long canyon floor runs between two high echo shelves.

goals: Build along the canyon floor and both echo shelves.
Watch the two open ends of the canyon.
rules: The canyon floor lies between west and east shelf grounds.
Waves enter from the north and south.
Both shelves stand above the central floor.
briefing.geographyLine: A long canyon floor between two high echo shelves, with enemy lanes entering from both ends.

manifest.name: The Dead Band
manifest.description: Board-launch-only until its contract-level signal-suppression consumer lands. Teaching intent: feel what agents contribute by losing drones, playbooks, and relay chains for one run.

objectiveMetadata.description: Secure the valley using hands, boots, and the four oldest tools without signal systems.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Nostalgia by subtraction: missing the drones is the lesson.

signalNullZones.description: Signal does not propagate anywhere inside the iron-ore shadow.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the contract-level drone, playbook, and relay-chain suppression consumer declared by this contract.

signalSuppression.description: No drones, no playbooks, and no relay chains operate in the Dead Band.

boardRow.name: The Dead Band
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: An iron valley holds one central yard between two old-tool grounds.

goals: Build across the central yard and both old-tool grounds.
Watch the three open approaches to the valley.
rules: The Dead Band reuses Relay Valley ground.
Three surveyed build grounds cross the iron valley.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
briefing.geographyLine: Relay Valley ground with one central iron yard between west and east old-tool grounds.

manifest.name: Relay Rush
manifest.description: Board-launch-only until its event-driven interference-front cycle and signal-muting consumer land. Teaching intent: expand under deadline and triage at speed.

objectiveMetadata.description: Light N relays before the interference front arrives.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Expansion under deadline; triage at speed.

interferenceFrontZones.description: A wall of static crosses this corridor on a schedule and mutes everything it swallows.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the event-driven interference-front cycle and signal-muting consumer declared by this contract.

interferenceFront.description: An event-driven wall of static crosses the map on a schedule and mutes everything it swallows.

boardRow.name: Relay Rush
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Four relay sites stand along the familiar ridge chain.

goals: Build across the four relay sites on the ridge chain.
Watch the north, west, and east approaches.
rules: Relay Rush reuses Relay Valley ground.
Four surveyed sites mark the ridge chain.
You stake the second relay ground; the other three want a walk.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
briefing.geographyLine: The Relay Valley ridge chain with four surveyed relay grounds along its map-wide corridor; the claim is staked on the second ground, where the guns can stand with you.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the declared atmosphere wall and suit-timer consumer; gravity physics already has a registered consumer.

boardRow.name: The Mare Claim
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A high crater rim rings dome pads, regolith fields, and an eastbound mass-driver.

goals: Build among the dome cluster and crater-rim pads.
Work the six regolith harvest grounds across the mare flat.
Watch the launch pad, lava-tube mouth, and eastbound mass-driver rail.
rules: The crater rim stands at height six above the mare flat.
Seven surveyed build grounds span the rim and mare flat.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
briefing.geographyLine: A height-six crater rim rings a height-zero mare with dome pads, regolith fields, a lava-tube mouth, launch pad, and eastbound mass-driver rail.

manifest.name: The Far Side
manifest.description: Mare Claim terrain variant. Engine dependency: map-wide signal suppression, suit-only atmosphere, and one-time crashed-probe playback consumers are not yet implemented. Teaching intent: remove Earth, drones, and playbooks so the town's first hello becomes the reward for crossing the loneliest map in the saga.

objectiveMetadata.description: Cross the comms shadow in a suit and recover the unmarked probe that kept the town's first wrong-number hello.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Homesickness by subtraction: the missing Earth, drones, and playbooks make the recovered voice matter.

probeRecoveryZones.description: A half-buried, unmarked old-world probe waits at the far end of the crossing.

signalNullZones.description: No playbooks or drones operate anywhere in the Far Side comms shadow.

engineDependencies.description: Signal suppression, probe recovery and playback have consumers, and the headless door now composes the suit-only atmosphere wall: the suit drains outside the landing yard and the crossing counts only on air. The BROWSER still composes no atmosphere consumer at all, so a player there meets no suit timer and this dependency stays missing until it does.

signalSuppression.description: The Far Side comms shadow disables drones and playbooks for the whole run.

probePlayback.description: The recovered probe plays the valley-to-lighthouse wrong-number call once at the map's end.

boardRow.name: The Far Side
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A landing yard faces a listening-probe crater across the Far Side.

goals: Cross from the landing yard to the listening-probe crater.
Build at the two surveyed grounds on opposite ends of the Far Side.
rules: Earth is absent from the sky.
The Far Side reuses the Mare Claim rim-and-flat ground.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
briefing.geographyLine: The Mare Claim rim-and-flat terrain with a landing yard at one end and the listening-probe crater at the other.

manifest.name: Low Orbit
manifest.description: Distinct non-ground scaffold tile. Engine dependency: zero-G movement, returning orbital projectiles, debris-terrain, and handhold-route consumers are not yet implemented. Teaching intent: momentum is commitment; every push and every missed lob remains a future problem.

objectiveMetadata.description: Cross the rebuilt Claw scaffold by handholds while returning misses and drifting debris keep every commitment in play.

engineDependencies.description: Zero-gravity projectile physics, the scaffold decks, the debris bands and the handhold spine all run, and the headless door now composes the suit-only atmosphere wall: crossing every authored deck on suit air is what opens the secure. The BROWSER still composes no atmosphere consumer at all, so this dependency stays missing until it does.

zeroGravity.description: The station scaffold is in free fall; missed lobs remain in orbit and return.

boardRow.name: Low Orbit
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: The Salvage King's rebuilt Claw spans three scaffold decks between two debris fields.

goals: Cross the salvaged Claw scaffold by its central spine.
Build across the carcass yard and both scaffold decks.
rules: Three surveyed decks divide the orbital yard.
Two debris fields flank the central spine.
Waves enter from the west and east.
briefing.geographyLine: The Salvage King's Claw rebuilt as a three-deck orbital yard, with a handhold spine between two drifting debris fields.

manifest.name: The Eclipse
manifest.description: Mare Claim terrain variant. Engine dependency: a one-shot event-driven eclipse cycle, mid-run solar shutdown, brown-out ledger, and dark-wave consumers are not yet implemented. Teaching intent: reserves are love letters to your future self.

objectiveMetadata.description: Keep the Mare Claim alive when an early lunar eclipse kills the solar economy in the middle of the run.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Reserves are love letters to your future self.

eclipseShadowZones.description: The eclipse shadow crosses the whole claim and ends solar production mid-run.

engineDependencies.description: The headless door now composes the atmosphere wall and the eclipse event: mid-run the shadow takes the solar-fed dome pads offline, leaves the pad nearest the claim as the reserve, and the secure then needs a regolith ground worked on suit air after it lands. The authored shadow-zone rectangle itself still has no consumer, and the BROWSER composes neither the atmosphere nor the eclipse, so this dependency stays missing.

eclipseEvent.description: A compressed lunar eclipse arrives mid-run, early and unannounced the first time, shutting down solar production and opening dark waves.

boardRow.name: The Eclipse
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: The Mare Claim's dome pads, regolith fields, and mass-driver return beneath a dark sky.

goals: Build among the Mare Claim's dome cluster and rim pads.
Work the six regolith harvest grounds across the flat.
rules: Seven surveyed build grounds span the rim and mare flat.
The eastbound mass-driver rail crosses the southern footing.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
briefing.geographyLine: The Mare Claim rim, dome cluster, regolith fields, launch pad, and mass-driver rail beneath a dark sky.

boardRow.name: The Dome Basin
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Cut the feeder canal, hold its three gates, and raise a town around the dry basin.

goals: Work the ice quarry above the basin.
Defend stage-gates C1, C2, and C3 along the feeder canal.
Build at the rim domes, weather spire, seed rows, and Ark yards while watching the dust-devil lane.
rules: The north ice-quarry scarp stands at height four above a central basin floor at height minus two.
The feeder canal begins dry; C1, C2, and C3 mark its stage gates.
Dust devils follow a telegraphed wander lane.
briefing.geographyLine: A height-four ice-quarry scarp feeds a dry canal through three stage gates into a height-minus-two basin ringed by domes, rows, the weather spire, and Ark yards.

manifest.name: The Seed Run
manifest.description: Engine dependency: profile-persistent planted-waypoint consumer not yet implemented. Teaching intent: spend escort strength now to create permanent shelter for future runs.

objectiveMetadata.description: Escort the seed-vault caravan to the basin and choose which vaults to plant along the route.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Investment across runs: present generosity becomes future shelter.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the profile-persistent planted-waypoint and objective consumers declared by this contract.

persistentPlanting.description: Each seed vault planted en route becomes a permanent green waypoint for future runs on this map.

boardRow.name: The Seed Run
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Escort the seed-vault caravan north over three planting grounds; the crossing is the claim.

goals: Escort the seed-vault caravan from the south yard to the north basin; the crossing is the contract.
Choose which vaults to plant at the west, center, and east waypoint stakes.
rules: The caravan rolls on its own and halts forty seconds at each waypoint ground.
Planting a vault spends a quarter of the caravan's guard and shelters that ground for every run after.
Outlaws that reach the caravan chew its guard down; waves enter from the west and east.
briefing.geographyLine: A seed-vault caravan crosses south to north over three planting grounds to the basin approach. Lose the caravan and the claim cannot be secured.

manifest.name: Devil's Alley
manifest.description: Engine dependency: scheduled moving-column pickup-and-relocation consumer not yet implemented. Teaching intent: anchor what matters and adapt when the wind replans the rest.

objectiveMetadata.description: Hold the alley while scheduled dust devils pick up and relocate unanchored buildings.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Attachment versus adaptation, with relocation played for laughs.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the scheduled moving-column relocation and objective consumers declared by this contract.

scheduledRelocation.description: Dust devils cross on schedules and relocate unanchored buildings instead of destroying them.

boardRow.name: Devil's Alley
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Three crosswind corridors cut between south and north yards through sheltered anchor bays.

goals: Cross the alley between the south and north anchor yards.
Build around the west, center, and east anchor bays.
rules: Three broad crosswind corridors divide the alley.
Five surveyed build grounds span the anchor yards and bays.
Waves enter from the west and east.
briefing.geographyLine: Three broad crosswind corridors cut an alley between south and north anchor yards, with protected bays set west, center, and east.

manifest.name: The Old Canal
manifest.description: Engine dependency: profile-persistent segment-choice and derived water-flow consumers not yet implemented. Teaching intent: edit inherited work segment by segment instead of erasing it wholesale.

objectiveMetadata.description: Choose whether to re-dig or demolish each inherited canal segment, changing its eventual flow forever.

engineDependencies.description: SATISFIED 2026-08-21 by A10 (src/systems/CanalChoiceSystem.ts, live in both engines): the profile-persistent segment choice, the derived flow and the objective latch all exist. The row survives because the schema has no status but 'missing' and DECLARED_INERT_PATHS obliges a non-empty list while twist.persistentCanalChoices is declared - see F-A10-2.

persistentCanalChoices.description: Each canal segment permanently remembers re-dig or demolish, and the final water route follows the combined choices.

boardRow.name: The Old Canal
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A crooked old canal crosses three marked grounds between a survey yard and northern outflow.

goals: Cross the three inherited canal grounds.
Build between the south survey yard and northern outflow.
rules: Three decision stakes mark the crooked canal line.
Five surveyed build grounds span the route.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
briefing.geographyLine: A crooked old Digger canal crosses three decision grounds between a south survey yard and the northern outflow.

manifest.name: The Ember Shore
manifest.description: Board-launch-only until its preserve-contract Static squall consumer lands.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the declared preserve warmth/stoke, squall scheduler, and secure-latch consumers; E10S-2 lands the scheduler and E10S-3 the preserve consumer.

boardRow.name: The Ember Shore
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Cooling lava-vein bands divide the last warm vent from a cooled titan.

goals: Build around the last warm vent.
Cross the safe approaches beneath the cooled titan machine.
Watch the north, west, and east edges of the dry shore.
rules: Cooling lava veins mark the shore's hazard bands.
The cooled titan machine stands beside the eastern build ground.
The Ember Shore has no river, ford, or water source.
briefing.geographyLine: Cooling lava-vein bands divide the dry shore between the last warm vent and a cooled titan machine older than the Combine.

manifest.name: The Archive World
manifest.description: Board-launch-only until procgen worlds v3, re-ink light-hold squalls, and persistent lore-unlock consumers land. Teaching intent: show what losing to the Static means by restoring a prior civilization one wing at a time.

objectiveMetadata.description: Hold light through Static squalls to re-ink one archive wing at a time; every rescued page unlocks real lore.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Show what losing would mean, never say it.

emptyShelfZone.description: An empty deep-stack shelf bears the pictogram meaning ours, unless.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the declared archive-wing, light-hold, empty-shelf, objective, procgen, and lore-unlock consumers.

boardRow.name: The Archive World
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Two ruined stack wings lead from the archive entry to a deep warning shelf.

goals: Cross from the archive entry through both ruined stack wings.
Build at the west stacks, east stacks, and warning shelf.
Reach the empty shelf at the deep end of the archive.
rules: Three light stakes mark the two wings and warning shelf.
Four surveyed build grounds span the archive.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
briefing.geographyLine: Two ruined stack wings lead from the archive entry to a deep warning shelf left empty for us, unless.

manifest.name: The Last Claim
manifest.description: Ark-deck variant: reuses the existing ark-plaza-e10 deck class and its ten lineage stations; no new terrain sculpt. Engine dependency: ordered deck-loss progression, Quiet desaturation and mix-duck rings, era-weapon gating, and the three-preserves finale are not yet implemented. Teaching intent: everything, one final time, in order.

objectiveMetadata.description: Cross ten era-decks from stern to bow while the Static consumes the ship behind you, then out-live the Quiet by preserving one light, one song, and one portrait.
objectiveMetadata.teachingIntent: Everything, one final time, in order.

engineDependencies.description: The warm vent objective is live; the remaining finale objective metadata still needs its broader consumer.

boardRow.name: The Last Claim
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Ten lineage decks run stern to bow and end at three small preserves.

goals: Keep the last warm vent alight through wave 8.
rules: The Ark carries ten lineage stations from stern to bow.
The Quiet drains color and song around the three preserves.
The Quiet is not damaged; the three preserves make it recede.
briefing.geographyLine: The Ark itself is the finale: ten lineage decks in a stern-to-bow run ending at three preserves.

manifest.name: The River
manifest.description: Post-credits-only through the Charter Press river lever. Reuses frontier-river-claim at dawn with no new sculpt; return to the first verb with no enemies, no waves, and one pan.

objectiveMetadata.description: Pan the dawn river while the credits names surface as gold flecks, then let the river keep going.

creditsRiverZone.description: Credits names surface here as gold flecks, one by one.

engineDependencies.description: Needs the declared credits-river band, gold-fleck zone, and objective consumers.

boardRow.name: The River
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: At dawn, with no enemies and no waves, the first river waits for one pan.

goals: Pan the river.
rules: There are no enemies and no waves.
The first claim returns with one river and one center ford.
With the waves quiet, the river keeps going.
briefing.geographyLine: The first claim returns at dawn: one river, one center ford, and one pan.
